__broaden__.βροτῶν: βροτός — mortal; masc. gen. pl., partitive after τίς: ’of mortals’ · also masc. gen. pl. after ἕνεκα: ’for the sake of mortals’ · also masc. gen. pl., gen. of comparison after περί: ’above all mortals’
__broaden__.δίφρου: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. gen. sg., of separation after verbs of throwing out and stepping down: ’from the chariot’ · also a seat, stool · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἐπιβαίνω: ’mounted the chariot’ (δίφρου ἐπεβήσετο) · also masc. gen. sg. after πρόσθ’: ’in front of the chariot’
__broaden__.δρῦς: δρῦς — oak; fem. acc. pl. (acc. pl. with long ῡ) · also fem. nom. sg., subject: ’an oak’
__broaden__.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (εἰς Ἄϊδος ’to Hades’)
__broaden__.εὐξαμένοιο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic εὐξαμένου), after ἔκλυες: ’when I prayed’ · also in a gen. absolute: ’as he boasted, declared aloud’
__broaden__.ἀσπίδι: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by his shield’ · also fem. dat. sg. after ὑπό: ’under the shield’ (ὑπ’ ἀσπίδι)
__broaden__.ἔσχετο: ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold; mid. hold before oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’held (before him)’ · also with ὑπό in tmesis (ὑπό … ἔσχετο = ὑπέσχετο): ’promised’
__broaden__.ἅλιόν: Ἅλιος — Halius, a Lycian warrior (also the adj. ἅλιος ’vain’); masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε · also ἅλιος — vain, fruitless; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in vain’ (οὐδ’ ἅλιον ’not in vain’)
__broaden__.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο)
__broaden__.ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’)
__broaden__.ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’) · also masc. gen. sg. after παρά: ’from a companion’ (παρ’ ἑταίρου) · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἀμέλησεν: ’neglect his companion’
__broaden__.ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ · also ἠέ = ἦε, ’or’, introducing a second question · also ἠέ, ’or’, introducing a further alternative in a list (ἠέ ποθι ’or somewhere’) · also ἠέ, ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠέ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’) · also ἠέ, ’than’, after a verb of wishing, with no comparative: ’rather than’ (δοῦναι κράτος ἠέ περ ἡμῖν ’to give strength rather than to us’) · also ἠέ … ἠέ, correlative ’either … or’, in a statement · also ἠέ … ἦέ, ’either … or’ (’whether … or’), in a direct double question (ἠέ τι βέβληαι … ἦέ τευ ἀγγελίης ’have you been hit … or have you come with news’) · also ἠέ … ἤ, correlative ’either … or’ in a statement (ἠέ τινα … ἢ αὐτός ’either someone … or he himself’)
